title: A Nonlinear Snell Envelope Representation for Path-Dependent Controller-Stopper Games
summary: We consider a finite-horizon, zero-sum stochastic differential game in which one player controls a path-dependent stochastic system, while the opponent is given the opportunity to terminate the game prematurely. We introduce a control randomization formulation, which allows us to establish that the upper and lower value functions coincide.
